description: Cross-implementation consistency fixture. A fixed 2-2-1 sigmoid MLP. Every port (a9nn, scm, rkt, raku, pl, isa) constructs this exact network and asserts the forward output and MSE loss to the given tolerance. Semantics: layer output = sigmoid(W . x + b) for every layer; loss = mean squared error. Reference values computed in double precision; the Isabelle/HOL port uses exact rational arithmetic with a truncated-series sigmoid, so it uses tolerance_isa.
